structured.reason: The description contains hedged, qualified statements about product performance, which the strict criterion treats as negative signal. (1) "Many customers also find the handle comfortable to hold." The qualifier "many customers" implies not all customers agree, and it reflects the mixed review content about grip comfort (one reviewer said "Hand Grip is too small"). (2) "BPA-free soft nylon bristles are designed to help remove stains, tartar, and plaque" uses hedged performance language ("designed to help") rather than a pure positive claim. Because the criterion says to lean toward failing when unsure, these hedges are enough to fail the description.
